_schema: Run 29 session 3 - independent MAIN-AGENT crosscheck (R7) + v2-hypothesis adjudication. This session's Phase-4 verifiers applied the params-v2 STRICT gate (any adjacency on EITHER axis => NARROW; OPEN only for zero adjacency on BOTH). Result: 0 verifier-OPEN (no optimism bias to correct this time). Main agent independently re-verified the load-bearing claims.
headline: v2 NO-INDUSTRIAL-ANALOG hypothesis: REFUTED at the strict capability-gap level (0/12 reached GAP_OPEN), but PARTIALLY VALIDATED at the correlation level (no-analog crafts collide less: 76% none/very-low AI vs 33% for partial-analog). All 12 candidates = GAP_NARROW.

v2_test_result.question: Do no-industrial-analog crafts yield GAP_OPEN (validating v2), or do they ALSO collide (refuting v2)?
v2_test_result.answer: They ALSO collide. v2 is REFUTED as a route to OPEN. Two independent collision mechanisms were found, one or both present in every candidate:
v2_test_result.mechanism_1_craft_has_research_AI: Many no-analog crafts ALREADY have research-stage AI on the craft itself: kodo monkoh -> 'Smell with Genji' (arXiv 2602.02785, CHI 2026, Transformer incense classifier) [main-agent CONFIRMED real]; organ voicing -> Ising dimensionless intonation number (closed-form) + DL voicing (Springer 2021, MDPI Sensors 2024); flint knapping -> CGAN virtual knapping (Sci Reports 2021); paper marbling -> 'Mathematical Marbling' closed-form + Navier-Stokes sims; cognac/aroma -> aroma-blend 'which combination works' ML (arXiv 2312.16124, 160k blend pairs); clay plasticity -> symbolic-regression plasticity models (R2=0.998); bonsai -> robotic living-plant shaping (arXiv 1804.06682).
v2_test_result.mechanism_2_technique_family_sibling: Even where the craft has ZERO AI (hedgelaying, solera, nerikoh), the fresh TECHNIQUE-FAMILY has a sibling foothold, so the strict gate returns NARROW: OmniVTA/visuo-tactile world models -> robot dough-kneading/deformable manipulation (2208.00386, 2107.06924, VIRDO++ 2210.03701); kooplearn/Koopman -> industrial CSTR-reactor blending + DeepKoopFormer/KIND forecasting.
v2_test_result.correlation_validation: From the Phase-2 cross-tab over 42 sourced concepts: has_industrial_analog='no' -> 76% (19/25) at none/very-low AI; 'partial' -> 33% (5/15). So the no-analog tag IS a real signal for LOWER penetration - just not for the absolute zero that GAP_OPEN requires.
